answer: A payout is split so that 59% arrives at settlement and the rest over 6 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. The cedar schedule is applied in opal and ember shows each instalment. Anyone therefore cannot take the money and run, since most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A farm of 1892 identities would post 4934 proofs and burn roughly 81 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
